For rim signs ±1 the signed cyclic determinant equals (prod rim r_i)(tr(P_{n-1}...P_0)-2), where det product=1. Transfer B=[[1,-1],[1,0]] obeys B^6=I, while D=[[3,-1],[1,0]]; the explicit sign sequences by n mod6 attain -1 for 3∤n and -4 for 3|n. Three-periodic (+1,+1,-1) spokes yield zero vector (1,1,2) at 3|n. Maximum |W|=number of spanning trees L_(2n)-2, giving exact Moore-Penrose and positive condition-number formula in counting normalization. Independently checked explicit signed-Laplacian determinants for wheel sizes 3..14, each matching the six-periodic proposed value. These finite checks do not prove the transfer identity in arbitrary size.
